title: FarmLander
tagline: FarmLander is a Decentralised Land MarketPlace for  farmers to buy/sell or rent their FarmLands
description:
FarmLander is a Decentralised Land MarketPlace for 
farmers to buy/sell or rent their FarmLands.
Farmers can list their FarmLands as NFTs or get Lands on rent,streaming the 
rent to owner per second instead of paying as whole.
It decentralizes the FarmLand marketplace and takes it a step further
The project makes use of WorldCoin,XMTP,SuperFluid,IPFS/Filecoin and Valist
how_its_made:
Solidity is used for coding the smart-contracts and React-js is used for the 
frontend along with SCSS with styling 
The project uses 
-Worldcoin widget in the frontend and smart-contract to ensure that a Land is only listed and converted into a NFT once 
-XMTP for providing chat functionality between buyers and sellers
-IPFS/Filecoin to upload the land images for NFTs
-Superfluid for streaming rent per second from Renters to Owners
-Valist for software distribution
